label: the night

label: the night

label: the broker's claim
intent: he bought the months honestly from earlier holders and has lost a season's hire (fact.mq03.broker-bought-honest); with the roll burnt, the two who heard it read will say what they owe and what the blank line is counted at, a hand bought with the gang; the barge is a day down the river with the rest, and his skiff leaves for Soulrest, the river port where he hires the gang out, at the next dawn with whatever hands he holds; colder if flag.mq01.manner-defied holds

label: her terms
intent: only after topic.mq03-whom-you-serve: the burnt roll leaves the broker only the two on the mats; she will put the Reed's coin to his price, and give what she knows of the courier he carried, on condition the player serves the Reed; she will not show him her face; she had Salts-The-Catch send him word herself, so the player bargains with her at their back

label: taking the coin
intent: the player takes the Reed's coin on her condition; she gives what she knows of the courier if skillAtLeast mercantile 15, or speakerDispositionAtLeast 50, or hasItem phial with skillAtLeast alchemy 15, else only the coin

label: refusing the coin
intent: the player refuses the coin and answers the broker's price some other way, or not at all: she gives what she knows of the courier, cooler, only if speakerDispositionAtLeast 50 or hasItem phial with skillAtLeast alchemy 15, else nothing

label: the house
intent: whose house this is, said as a trader says it: she keeps it for a customer and asks no more, and the broker buys her fish too; she sent him word because she was asked to, and says by whom no more; he came to her door himself and she thinks two hands and a stranger a poor thing to bring into her house (the one voice in the room that doubts his claim); a release spoken before a trader is a release kept; she will not hear the state's business said in her house until dispositionAtLeast 40 (persuaded), and starts colder if flag.mq01.manner-defied holds

label: the witnesses
intent: only after both the survivor's and Finds-The-Other-Bank's topic.mq03-bear-witness were heard, or when either is dead: they will not swear, and nobody else who heard the roll is here, the barge being a day down the river; he concedes it, and says that a hurt hand he cannot prove a claim on he will still take to Soulrest at dawn

label: the price
intent: only when topic.mq03-take-coin was heard: Salts-The-Catch counts the Reed's coin out to him; he concedes his season's hire is paid

intent: only when the player has what Nesh-Deeka gave of the courier (fact.mq03.courier-lever) and Salts-The-Catch is alive and persuaded (dispositionAtLeast 40): that Lilmoth will hear he carried the state's man and took its coin, said before a Lilmoth trader; he concedes he would rather that went unsaid; below skillAtLeast speechcraft 20, unless Salts-The-Catch is won to 60, he closes this answer with his own line and leaves the other two

label: the release, mine
intent: only when two of objectives o-witness, o-price and o-name are complete and Salts-The-Catch lives: he speaks the release of the player's months before Salts-The-Catch and the survivor; nobody may speak of them again

intent: only when two of objectives o-witness, o-price and o-name are complete, the survivor lives and Salts-The-Catch lives: he speaks the release of the survivor's months before Salts-The-Catch and the player, and says he will find a witness for the blank line

intent: at the Lilmoth dock after the dream: after e-mine he is civil and says the player's months are not his to speak of; after e-theirs and e-no-release he says he will find someone who heard the roll read and the player will hear of it; after e-nesh-dead he asks whose hand now stands behind the player and says nothing more

label: the Hist
intent: asks who sent the player and what the Hereguard camp's cutting looked like; says the leeches closed the tree in Pays-Late's keeping (she believes it, for a cut named in the village would set the kaal's spears on a hand raised against the tree), that Pays-Late asked her for days and she gave them, and that she hears it before the Hist when the player has something to put to her; names the Lilmoth man on the jetty asking after strangers and says she does not trust him; gives leave to see the tending-ground once her regard is 30 (she begins guarded, at 18)

label: the night of the netting
intent: once her regard is 30 (she begins at 20, ashamed): the one night of the month the netters go to the weirs and she keeps the pool, awake, with the second tender asleep; a boat with two men came in by the north reeds and went back out north towards the dry rise, and she took it for a netter, which shames her; the workshop door had no bar until that morning; the lowest pool's eggs were cold by morning and the leeches came after; the herald will hear it at the fence; a Lilmoth man asks on the jetty; of the cut she says nothing until the player has seen the root and puts it to her, and then that Pays-Late told her of it and she keeps it

label: the cut root
intent: only when the player holds the leech or has heard topic.mq04-the-weirs or has watched him wash the cut (he talks because he has been seen), has seen the cut, and his regard is 20 (he begins at 10): he admits he found the cut, told only the egg-tender, washes it every night, that his knife was gone and his workshop unbarred as always and barred that morning; he followed the gum north as far as the leech water and lost it, and thinks it went on north; he did not ask the spears or the netters to search, for it would show the cut sealed with his gum

label: before the village
intent: only after topic.mq04-the-weirs, and only at the fence: she will say before the village what she saw on the netting night, though it means owning that she took the boat for a netter

label: the hearing
intent: she hears whether the tree closed through Pays-Late's keeping; the award if it did: an apology before the Hist and nushmeekos of work at the tending-ground and the weirs; what she will hear: the jars and a second sign of the strangers, a surety, or nothing; the cut shown without a stranger's sign she reads against him (the gum and the missing knife are his) and the award stands

label: the jars
intent: only when the player holds thing.mq04.sap-jars (always at the fence): the jars and the gum; with a second sign she finds it a cut; alone, she says it is a story without a second sign in it and reads the cut against him

label: the bound man
intent: only when a cell man is in the player's custody at the fence: he says before the village, defiantly and in the cell's cause, not as a confession, that they cut it with the tree-minder's knife, which lies at their camp, and drew its sap into the jars; with a second sign she finds it a cut; she asks whether the village keeps him or the stranger's boat takes him

label: the leech
intent: only when the player holds thing.mq04.leech: thick only at the cut root and the lowest pool, none in the pools above, so it came after the sap was spilled; a second sign, never the first

label: the handing
intent: only after topic.mq04-show-man and the root-herald's leave (her second sign found: she finds it a cut): asks where the bound man is; says the stranger asks for the culprits, not the tree, and names no master; takes the man down to the boat

label: for Pays-Late
intent: the player stands surety for the tree-minder, taking his nushmeekos of work at the weirs on themselves (worked off at the weirs by day); she may accept it, and the work is then the player's; if she does not, the award stands

label: let the award stand
intent: the player says nothing; she finds it his keeping: an apology before the Hist and nushmeekos of work at the tending-ground and the weirs

label: the village keeps him
intent: only after topic.mq04-show-man: the player says the village keeps the bound man; he is no party to a hearing on Pays-Late and she does not hear him; the kaal's spears hold him until she sets him a counted award of nushmeekos of work at the weirs and the tending-ground, mending what he cut, witnessed; when it is worked he goes, and it is not spoken of again

label: the washing
intent: only when the player has watched Pays-Late wash the cut root by night: she hears that he found the cut and said nothing out of fear of what it would look like, a sign that the root was cut and not failed; a second sign, never the first

label: Helstrom

label: the first Hist
intent: an outside hand cut the trees and the tree-minders alone must watch them; she asks the player who sent them

label: the first Hist
intent: a Hist's turning is its own act, to be read and not clamped; he gives a reading freely and asks nothing for it

label: the answer
intent: the three answers

label: for the Tree-Minders
intent: the player says tree-minders alone at every tree

label: for the reading
intent: the player argues that a closed tree may be read by any who mean it well, and not clamped

label: the turning and the cut

label: the sick root
intent: the Conclave's commission: the Hist is sickening, the village blames the salt works; he stopped buying their salt a year ago

label: the sick root
intent: the salt works foul her spring; nothing of Greenspring's does

label: the sick root
intent: the leaves and the sap; he will not guess the cause

label: the cut in the roots
intent: shown the tool-marks he reads the founders' stakes aloud and names the dead grove

label: the cut in the roots
